You're buying above single PRINTS. 🔍

The morning rally from 24,450 to 24,560 was so fast that the profile only printed one TPO per price between 24,505 and 24,535. Those single prints mark initiative buying, but also an unfinished area the auction often comes back to test. Buying the top at 24,560 means sitting through that retest with -1.5R of heat. The better trade came when price returned into the single prints, responsive buyers defended 24,505 and the rally resumed.

1️⃣ A fast, one-sided move leaves single prints in the profile
2️⃣ Don't chase above them: price often returns to test the thin zone
3️⃣ Enter on the retest only if buyers defend it; if price trades straight through, the initiative is gone
